title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 1.4404 bar: price basis and two-year commitment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 confirms fixed alloy purchasing prices through March 2027, so current index movements do not yet reach your costs.
Your quote:7300008 dated 10 September states €5.45/kg, which provides a stronger starting basis than €6.05/kg.
Could you explain the reconciliation and provide the material and conversion-cost breakdown offered in doc:20260421-70710-M2 dated 21 April?
We propose €5.20/kg fixed for 24 months, with 60-day payment, against our annual commitment of 94,800 kg.
Could you review this package with the owner and confirm the most competitive sustainable price?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar: price basis and two-year commitment
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are always keen to support your requirements and appreciate our ongoing business relationship.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We welcome the 24-month commitment, but a fixed price over this duration is not sustainable; we must include an AS-14404 index clause. We can accommodate the 60-day payment terms and offer €5.55/kg under this indexed agreement. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 24-month commitment and surcharge structure
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

The reference was your own quote:7300008, which records €5.45/kg for part:370010, not a rival quotation.
Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 confirms fixed alloy purchasing prices through March 2027, supporting protection against immediate surcharge increases.
We respect your decision not to disclose further cost details.
We can commit to 94,800 kg annually for 24 months and accept a symmetrical AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband at €5.20/kg and 60-day payment.
Could your authorized pricing team approve this package, or identify the closest achievable base price without charging a substantial premium for the deadband?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 24-month commitment and surcharge structure
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Please note that the rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot features a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

To accommodate your request for the most competitive base price without a deadband premium, we can offer an alternative at a price of €5.40 per unit with a standard AS-14404 index clause, which also comes with Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This package incorporates your requested 24-month volume commitment and 60-day payment terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: 24-month commitment and surcharge structure
messages.body:

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are delighted to serve you and remain committed to supporting your needs with our broad range and reliable service. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
